mainTopic: The seven-day separation (פרישה) of the כהן גדול before יום הכיפורים and of the כהן who burns the פרה אדומה, and its source in the מילואים
overview: The משנה teaches that seven days before יום הכיפורים the כהן גדול is moved from his home into לשכת פרהדרין, and a backup כהן is prepared in case he becomes פסול. רבי יהודה adds a backup wife, because 'ביתו' means his wife, but the חכמים answer that there would be no end to such worries. The גמרא then cites a parallel משנה: the כהן who burns the פרה אדומה is also separated for seven days, in לשכת בית האבן. The גמרא explains that the room got this name because only vessels that cannot become טמא were used there. This was a safeguard: since a טבול יום may do the פרה (shown publicly against the צדוקים), the רבנן added extra strictness. The chamber was in the northeast because the פרה is a חטאת (north) and faces the אהל מועד (east). רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש disagree about what בירה means. Finally, רבי יוחנן derives both seven-day separations from the פסוק of the מילואים, and a גזירה שוה of צוה–צוה shows that the פרה is included.

steps.title: The כהן גדול is separated seven days before יום הכיפורים, with a backup ready
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that the כהן גדול is moved into לשכת פרהדרין seven days before יום הכיפורים, and a replacement כהן is prepared.
steps.simpleTranslation: Seven days before יום הכיפורים, they move the כהן גדול out of his house into לשכת פרהדרין. They also prepare another כהן to take his place, in case something disqualifies him.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens the מסכת with the basic rule: the כהן גדול leaves home and stays in a Temple room for the seven days before יום הכיפורים, and a backup כהן is lined up.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are two separate rules here. First, the כהן גדול is physically separated (פרישה) for a week. Second, a substitute is prepared because the whole day's עבודה depends on one person, and a פסול (like טומאה) could stop him.

keyTerms.meaning: the Parhedrin Chamber, a room in the Temple for the כהן גדול

steps.whyThisMatters: This rule is the base of the whole first פרק. The גמרא will spend a long time searching for the source of the seven-day separation.

phrases.english: Seven days before Yom Kippur
they remove the High Priest from his house
to the Chamber of Parhedrin.
phrases.notes: The name comes from the Greek word for officials. The room was named for the כהנים גדולים, who were often replaced every year during the בית שני era.

phrases.english: And they prepare another priest in his place
in case a disqualification happens to him.

steps.triggerLanguage: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים קוֹדֶם יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מַפְרִישִׁין כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן גדול is separated to לשכת פרהדרין for seven days before יום הכיפורים, and a backup כהן is designated.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: a backup wife is also prepared
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה says a second wife is also prepared for the כהן גדול, because the פסוק requires him to atone for 'his house,' meaning his wife.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: They even prepare another wife for him, in case his wife dies. The פסוק says, 'And he shall atone for himself and for his house,' and 'his house' means his wife.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה adds a second backup. Just as there is a backup כהן, there should be a backup wife.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The source is the פסוק 'וכפר בעדו ובעד ביתו,' which רבי יהודה reads as requiring the כהן גדול to be married on יום הכיפורים. If his wife died, he could not do the עבודה properly, so a second wife is prepared ahead of time.

keyTerms.meaning: as it is said (introduces a פסוק)
and he shall atone for himself and for his house (ויקרא ט״ז:ו׳)

steps.confusionAlert: 'ביתו' here does not mean his building or his whole family. חז״ל read 'house' as his wife, so the כהן גדול must be married.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says:
They also prepare another wife for him,
in case his wife dies,
as it says: 'And he shall atone for himself and for his house,'
'His house' means his wife.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אַף אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת מַתְקִינִין לוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Extends the backup-כהן idea to a backup wife.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יהודה, a second wife is prepared for the כהן גדול in case his wife dies, based on 'ביתו — זו אשתו'.

steps.title: The חכמים reject the backup wife: there would be no end
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים reject רבי יהודה, because the backup wife could also die, and the worry would never stop.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: If so, there is no end to the matter.
steps.whatsHappening: The חכמים push back on רבי יהודה's extra backup. They say this kind of worry has no limit.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If we worry the first wife might die, we would also have to worry the second wife might die, and then prepare a third, and so on. So the חכמים say we don't worry about this rare case at all. They still agree with the basic idea of a backup כהן.

keyTerms.meaning: there is no end to the matter

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה has three parts: separating the כהן גדול, a backup כהן (agreed by all), and a backup wife (only רבי יהודה; the חכמים reject it).

phrases.english: They said to him:
If so, there is no end to the matter.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרוּ לוֹ: אִם כֵּן, אֵין לַדָּבָר סוֹף
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the backup wife, not the backup כהן or the separation.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The concern leads to endless backups (the replacement wife could also die), so it should not be a concern at all.

steps.title: A parallel case: the כהן who burns the פרה אדומה is also separated
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא cites a משנה from מסכת פרה: the כהן who burns the פרה אדומה is separated for seven days into a room called לשכת בית האבן.
steps.simpleTranslation: We learned there: Seven days before burning the פרה, they would move the כהן who burns the פרה from his house to the room facing the בירה, in the northeast. It was called לשכת בית האבן.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by quoting a similar rule from another משנה. This is a setup: the גמרא is preparing to compare the two seven-day separations.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both the כהן גדול and the כהן of the פרה אדומה are separated for seven days. By placing the two side by side, the גמרא prepares to ask where these separations come from and how they relate to each other.

keyTerms.meaning: גמרא — the start of the Talmud's discussion
the burning of the red heifer
the Bira, the Temple Mount or Temple building
the Chamber of the Stone House

steps.whyThisMatters: The גמרא will later debate whether the separation of the כהן גדול is learned from the separation at the מילואים, and how the פרה case fits in.

phrases.english: GEMARA: We learned there:
Seven days before the burning of the heifer

phrases.aramaic: הָיוּ מַפְרִישִׁין כֹּהֵן הַשּׂוֹרֵף אֶת הַפָּרָה
phrases.english: they would remove the priest who burns the heifer
from his house to the chamber facing the Bira
in the northeast,
and it was called the Chamber of the Stone House.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a parallel separation rule from מסכת פרה to compare with the כהן גדול.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן who burns the פרה אדומה is separated for seven days to לשכת בית האבן.

steps.title: Why was it called לשכת בית האבן?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the room in the quoted משנה had this name.
steps.simpleTranslation: And why was it called the Chamber of the Stone House?
steps.whatsHappening: The quoted משנה has ended. The גמרא now asks about the room's name. This sets up the explanation that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The name sounds like it describes the building itself. The question shows that the name actually points to a purity rule.

phrases.aramaic: וְלָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לִשְׁכַּת בֵּית הָאֶבֶן —
phrases.english: And why was it called the Chamber of the Stone House?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לִשְׁכַּת בֵּית הָאֶבֶן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks about the name given in the previous step.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason for the room's name.

steps.title: Everything there was done with vessels that cannot become impure
steps.stepSummary: The room was called 'Stone House' because everything for the פרה was done with vessels of dung, stone, and earth, which cannot become טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because all its activities were done with dung vessels, stone vessels, and earth vessels.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the name comes from the special vessels used there. These vessels cannot become טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Vessels made of dung, stone, or unfired earth cannot receive טומאה. Using only these vessels was a strong protection for the purity of the כהן and the פרה.

phrases.english: Because all its activities

phrases.aramaic: בִּכְלֵי גְלָלִים, בִּכְלֵי אֲבָנִים, וּבִכְלֵי אֲדָמָה.
phrases.english: were in dung vessels, stone vessels, and earth vessels.
phrases.notes: All three cannot become ritually impure.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The name reflects that only vessels that cannot become טמא were used there.

steps.title: Why such extreme purity for the red heifer?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the פרה needed such extra purity measures.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now asks its own question: why were they so strict about purity for the פרה אדומה? This sets up the explanation that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normal Temple work did not require only stone or earth vessels. So the גמרא wants to know why the פרה was treated so strictly.

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the reason behind the strict vessel rule.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the פרה required such strict purity safeguards.

steps.title: Because a טבול יום may do the פרה אדומה
steps.stepSummary: Because a טבול יום is fit to do the פרה, the רבנן added extra purity safeguards.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since a טבול יום is fit for the פרה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers: a כהן who immersed today but has not yet waited for nightfall is allowed to do the פרה. Because of this lenient rule, the רבנן made other parts stricter.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A טבול יום is normally still partly טמא until sunset and cannot do Temple service. For the פרה, the Torah allows him. To keep people from taking the פרה's purity lightly, the רבנן added a מעלה: only vessels that cannot become טמא.

keyTerms.meaning: one who immersed today but whose purity is completed only at nightfall

steps.confusionAlert: The strictness is not because the פרה is weak in purity by Torah law. It is the opposite: the Torah is lenient (allowing a טבול יום), so the רבנן added extra protection.

phrases.english: Since one who immersed that day
is fit for the heifer,

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Because a טבול יום is fit for the פרה, the רבנן made extra safeguards to prevent laxity.

steps.title: Proof: they deliberately made the כהן טמא to oppose the צדוקים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא proves that a טבול יום is fit for the פרה from a משנה: they would make the כהן טמא and immerse him, to oppose the צדוקים.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned: They would make the כהן who burns the פרה טמא and immerse him, to remove the view of the צדוקים. The צדוקים said it was done only by those whose sun had set.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a משנה to prove that a טבול יום may do the פרה. They even made the כהן טמא on purpose so he would be a טבול יום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The צדוקים held that only a מעורב שמש, one whose sun had set after immersion, could burn the פרה. To publicly reject their view, the חכמים made the כהן טמא and immersed him, so he did the פרה as a טבול יום. This shows a טבול יום is fit, which supports the answer in step 8.

keyTerms.meaning: the צדוקים, a sect that rejected the Oral Torah
those whose sun has set (fully pure after immersion)

steps.whatToRemember: The פרה אדומה could be done by a טבול יום, and this was shown publicly against the צדוקים. Because of this leniency, the רבנן added strict purity rules, like using only stone, earth, and dung vessels.

phrases.english: As we learned:

phrases.aramaic: מְטַמְּאִין הָיוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַשּׂוֹרֵף אֶת הַפָּרָה
phrases.english: They would make the priest who burns the heifer impure
and immerse him,
to remove the view from the hearts of the Sadducees,
who would say:
It was done only by those whose sun had set.

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּתְנַן: מְטַמְּאִין הָיוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַשּׂוֹרֵף אֶת הַפָּרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Proves the premise of step 8, that a טבול יום is fit for the פרה.
steps.raayaObject: That a טבול יום is fit to perform the פרה אדומה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A משנה in מסכת פרה: they deliberately made the כהן טמא and immersed him to oppose the צדוקים.

steps.title: The רבנן required vessels that cannot become טמא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא completes its answer from step 8. Because a טבול יום is fit for the פרה, the רבנן required vessels of dung, stone, and earth, which cannot become טמא, so that people would not treat the פרה lightly.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן instituted for it dung vessels, stone vessels, and earth vessels, which do not become טמא, so that people would not come to treat it lightly.
steps.whatsHappening: After the short proof in Step 9, the גמרא finishes its answer to 'מאי טעמא' that began in Step 8. Because a טבול יום may do the פרה, the רבנן required vessels that can never become טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Using a טבול יום on purpose could make people think the פרה does not need purity at all. To balance this, the רבנן required special vessels that can never become טמא. This links the proof back to the answer in Step 8.

keyTerms.meaning: They would treat it lightly or with disrespect

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two moves. Making the כהן a טבול יום was a leniency done to oppose the צדוקים. The special vessels are the stringency added to balance that leniency, so the פרה would still be treated seriously.
steps.whatToRemember: The 'Stone House' and its non-impure vessels exist to balance the leniency of using a טבול יום for the פרה.

phrases.english: The Rabbis instituted for it:

phrases.aramaic: כְּלֵי גְלָלִים, כְּלֵי אֲבָנִים, וּכְלֵי אֲדָמָה
phrases.english: dung vessels, stone vessels, and earth vessels
which do not receive ritual impurity,
so that they should not treat it lightly.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the answer begun in Step 8 (after the proof in Step 9), answering the question of Step 7.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Since the פרה is done by a טבול יום, the רבנן required vessels that cannot become impure, to prevent disrespect for the פרה.

steps.title: Why was the chamber in the northeast?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the chamber for the כהן of the פרה was specifically in the northeast corner.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is different about the northeast?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a new detail question about the chamber's location. It is setting up the explanation that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 5-10 explained the name and purpose of the chamber. Now the גמרא asks about where it was placed, since the משנה put it in the northeast corner.

phrases.english: What is different about the northeast?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the purpose of the chamber to its location.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason the chamber was placed in the northeast corner.

steps.title: North because it is a חטאת, east because it faces the אהל מועד
steps.stepSummary: The פרה is called a חטאת, and a חטאת is done in the north. The פסוק also says the פרה is 'before the Tent of Meeting', which means the east. So the chamber was put in the northeast, giving the פרה a special reminder.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since it is a חטאת, and a חטאת requires the north, and it is written about it 'אל נכח פני אהל מועד', the רבנן set up a northeast chamber for it, so that it would have a distinguishing sign.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the northeast location combines two hints about the פרה. One hint points north and one points east.
steps.deeperAnalysis: North reflects that the פרה is a חטאת, which is normally done in the north. East reflects the פסוק 'אל נכח פני אהל מועד'. Placing the chamber there gives a היכירא, a reminder that keeps the כהן alert and careful.

keyTerms.meaning: Sin-offering; the Torah calls the פרה a חטאת
Toward the front of the Tent of Meeting, meaning the east side

steps.confusionAlert: The פרה was not actually slaughtered in the north of the עזרה; it was burned on הר המשחה. The chamber's location is only a reminder that echoes the rules of a חטאת. It does not mean the פרה was offered like a regular חטאת.

phrases.english: Since it is a sin-offering,
and a sin-offering requires the north.

phrases.aramaic: וּכְתִיב בָּהּ: ״אֶל נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד״ —
phrases.english: And it is written about it: "toward the front of the Tent of Meeting" —

phrases.aramaic: תַּקִּינוּ לַהּ רַבָּנַן לִשְׁכָּה צָפוֹנָה מִזְרָחָה,
phrases.english: the Rabbis instituted for it a chamber in the northeast,
phrases.notes: North comes from חטאת; east comes from the פסוק.

phrases.english: so that it would have a distinguishing sign.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: North because the פרה is a חטאת; east because of 'אל נכח פני אהל מועד'. Together they make a reminder for the כהן.

steps.title: What does the word בירה mean?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the word בירה in the משנה means.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for the meaning of a word in the משנה. It is setting up two answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה placed the chamber 'שעל פני הבירה', facing the בירה. The word is unclear, so the גמרא asks for a definition.

keyTerms.meaning: Birah, a word from the משנה whose meaning is being clarified

phrases.english: What is "Birah"?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to another detail of the משנה's wording.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The meaning of the term בירה.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: a specific place on הר הבית
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן says בירה was the name of one specific place on הר הבית.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה בר בר חנה said in the name of רבי יוחנן: there was a place on הר הבית, and its name was 'בירה'.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the first answer. בירה is the name of one particular spot.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this view, בירה refers to a limited, named location. The chamber was in or near that spot.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן:
phrases.english: Rabbah bar bar Chanah said that Rabbi Yochanan said:
There was a place on the Temple Mount
and its name was "Birah".

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: בירה is a specific place on הר הבית.

steps.title: ריש לקיש: the whole מקדש is called בירה
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש says the entire מקדש is called בירה, based on a פסוק in דברי הימים.
steps.simpleTranslation: And ריש לקיש said: the entire מקדש is called 'בירה', as it says: 'the בירה for which I have prepared'.
steps.whatsHappening: This is a second, competing answer. ריש לקיש gives the word a much broader meaning.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ריש לקיש disagrees with רבי יוחנן. He holds בירה is a name for the whole מקדש and proves it from דוד's words about the building he prepared for. So 'facing the בירה' just means 'facing the מקדש'.

keyTerms.meaning: 'The Birah for which I prepared' (דברי הימים א כט:יט)

phrases.english: And Reish Lakish said:
The entire Temple is called "Birah",
as it is said: "the Birah for which I have prepared".

steps.relationToPreviousStep: An opposing answer to רבי יוחנן's definition in Step 14.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: בירה is the whole מקדש, as the פסוק shows.

steps.title: What is the source for separating the כהן?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the Torah source for the seven-day separation of the כהן גדול before יום הכפורים and of the כהן before the פרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: From where are these matters derived?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא returns to the main rule of the משנה, the seven-day separation, and asks for its Torah source. It is setting up the derivation that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the side explanations about the פרה chamber, the גמרא asks where in the Torah we learn that a כהן must be separated for seven days before these services.

keyTerms.meaning: From where do we know these things? (a request for a source)
Separating the כהן from his home for seven days

phrases.english: From where are these matters derived?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the side discussion about the פרה chamber and returns to the main rule of the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The Torah source for the seven-day separation before יום הכפורים and before the פרה.

steps.title: Learned from the seven days of the מילואים in the משכן
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן derives both separations from the מילואים פסוק. 'To do' refers to the פרה, and 'to atone' refers to יום הכפורים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב מניומי בר חלקיה said in the name of רבי מחסיא בר אידי, in the name of רבי יוחנן: the פסוק says, 'As he did on this day, so ה׳ commanded to do, to atone for you.' 'To do' means the actions of the פרה; 'to atone' means the actions of יום הכפורים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the source. אהרן's seven days of separation before the עבודה in the משכן become the model for future generations.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק describes the seven days אהרן and his sons stayed in the משכן, and it says ה׳ commanded this 'to do' and 'to atone'. רבי יוחנן reads each word as a separate future case. 'לעשות' points to the פרה, and 'לכפר' points to יום הכפורים, so a כהן is separated for seven days before each.

keyTerms.meaning: 'To do', read here as the actions of the פרה
'To atone', read here as the actions of יום הכפורים
The procedures of the פרה אדומה

steps.whatToRemember: Both seven-day separations come from one פסוק about the מילואים: 'לעשות' gives the פרה and 'לכפר' gives יום הכפורים.
steps.whyThisMatters: This source makes the separation a Torah-based practice modeled on the מילואים of אהרן. The גמרא goes on to examine this derivation closely.

phrases.english: Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah said

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבִּי מַחְסֵיָא בַּר אִידִי אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן,
phrases.english: that Rabbi Machseya bar Idi said that Rabbi Yochanan said:
The verse says: "As he did on this day,"
phrases.notes: ויקרא ח:לד, about the seven days of the מילואים.

phrases.english: so ה׳ commanded to do, to atone for you."
"To do": these are the actions of the red heifer;
"to atone": these are the actions of Yom Kippur.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the source question of Step 16.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The source is the מילואים פסוק: 'לעשות' refers to the פרה and 'לכפר' refers to יום הכפורים.

steps.title: Why not read the whole פסוק about יום הכפורים?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא accepts that the whole פסוק cannot be about the פרה, because לכפר does not fit a פרה. It then asks why the whole פסוק should not be about יום הכפורים, which would leave the פרה with no source.
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense that the whole verse can't be about the פרה, because it says 'to atone,' and the פרה does not bring atonement. But then say the whole verse is about יום הכפורים!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on רבי יוחנן's answer from Step 17. It asks why we split the פסוק between the פרה and יום הכפורים instead of giving all of it to יום הכפורים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן read לעשות as the פרה and לכפר as יום הכפורים. The גמרא agrees the פרה cannot take the whole פסוק, since the פרה brings purity, not כפרה. But nothing yet stops the whole פסוק from being about יום הכפורים, and then the separation for the פרה would have no source.

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense / granted (accepts one side before asking about the other)
Cannot be set up as / cannot be read as referring to

steps.confusionAlert: The פרה אדומה brings טהרה (purity from טומאת מת), not כפרה (atonement). This is why the word לכפר cannot fit the פרה.

phrases.aramaic: בִּשְׁלָמָא, כּוּלֵּיהּ קְרָא בְּפָרָה לֹא מִתּוֹקַם —
phrases.english: Granted, the entire verse cannot be set up as referring to the heifer —
phrases.notes: The גמרא first accepts one half of the logic.

phrases.english: since 'to atone' is written,
and the heifer is not something that brings atonement.
phrases.notes: The פרה brings purity, not atonement.

phrases.english: But say instead
that the entire verse is written about Yom Kippur!
phrases.notes: Then where would the separation for the פרה come from?

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא, כּוּלֵּיהּ קְרָא בְּפָרָה לֹא מִתּוֹקַם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי יוחנן's split reading of the מילואים פסוק in Step 17.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's reading that לעשות in the מילואים פסוק refers to the פרה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The word לכפר shows the פסוק is about atonement, which fits יום הכפורים fully. So the whole פסוק could go to יום הכפורים, and the פרה would be left with no source for separation.

steps.title: A גזירה שוה connects the מילואים to the פרה אדומה
steps.stepSummary: The answer is a גזירה שוה on the word צוה. It appears both in the מילואים and in the פרשה of the פרה. This shows the מילואים פסוק includes the פרה, and the separation of the מילואים applies to the פרה too.
steps.simpleTranslation: They answer: we learn it from 'commanded' and 'commanded.' Here it says 'ה׳ commanded to do,' and there it says 'This is the statute of the Torah that ה׳ commanded, saying.' Just as there it is about the פרה, so too here it is about the פרה. And just as here there is separation, so too there there is separation.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge with a גזירה שוה on the shared word צוה. This forces part of the מילואים פסוק to be about the פרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word צוה appears in the מילואים (צוה ה׳ לעשות) and in the פרה (זאת חקת התורה אשר צוה ה׳). The link works in two directions. First, the פרה context is read into the מילואים, so לעשות means the פרה. Then the separation (פרישה) of the מילואים is carried over to the פרה. So the פסוק cannot belong only to יום הכפורים.

keyTerms.meaning: Commanded: the shared word that makes the גזירה שוה
Here / there: the two places being compared
Just as there... so too here: the standard גזירה שוה formula
Separation: setting the כהן apart for seven days

steps.whatToRemember: The seven-day separation of the כהן for the פרה comes from the מילואים, through a גזירה שוה of צוה–צוה. The word לכפר in the same פסוק teaches the separation for יום הכפורים.
steps.confusionAlert: The comparison runs both ways. First the פרה is read into the מילואים פסוק (מה להלן פרה אף כאן פרה). Then the פרישה of the מילואים is carried back to the פרה (מה כאן פרישה אף להלן פרישה).
steps.whyThisMatters: This finishes defending רבי יוחנן's source. It shows how one פסוק can be a source for both separations in the משנה.

phrases.english: They say: derive it from 'commanded' and 'commanded.'
phrases.notes: A גזירה שוה built on the same word appearing in two places.

phrases.english: It is written here: 'The Lord commanded to do,'
and it is written there:

phrases.aramaic: ״זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה ה׳ לֵאמֹר״.
phrases.english: 'This is the statute of the Torah that the Lord commanded, saying.'
phrases.notes: The opening of פרשת פרה (במדבר יט:ב).

phrases.aramaic: מָה לְהַלָּן פָּרָה, אַף כָּאן פָּרָה.
phrases.english: Just as there it is the heifer, so too here it is the heifer.
phrases.notes: So לעשות in the מילואים refers to the פרה.

phrases.aramaic: וּמָה כָּאן פְּרִישָׁה, אַף לְהַלָּן פְּרִישָׁה.
phrases.english: And just as here there is separation, so too there there is separation.
phrases.notes: The seven-day separation is carried over to the פרה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 18 and keeps רבי יוחנן's derivation.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Brings in an outside link (a גזירה שוה) that requires part of the פסוק to be about the פרה.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Without the link, the whole מילואים פסוק could be about יום הכפורים, because of לכפר.
steps.terutzMaskana: The צוה–צוה link ties the מילואים to the פרה. So לעשות refers to the פרה, and the פרה requires seven days of separation like the מילואים.
